visual.general_description: Grayscale head image dominated by bright branching vessel-like structures inside a faint head outline, with no printed text.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale image of a head with a faint soft-tissue outline on a black background. A thick, bright, vertical midline vessel-like structure runs from the top of the head downward and ends in a bright, broad curved band that sweeps toward the image left. A second bright band extends from the lower midline toward the lower image right and is shorter and thinner than the band on the image left. Many thin bright branching vessels fan out over both sides of the head, and a bright tortuous vessel runs down the lower image left edge. The image has no panel letters, arrows, text labels, scale bar, side markers or burned-in text.
